fields.text: Text → Recraft V4.1 Vector (`recraft-ai/recraft-v4.1/text-to-vector`) → editable SVG mark. ~$0.08. Not a PNG sticker / BiRefNet cutout and not the Muse favicon.

Single geometric lightning-chevron mark for Volt, a pocket night-ride radio brand. Sharp electric-cyan (#00E5FF) chevron on a flat matte-charcoal (#1A1A1E) square. Clean vector paths, bold silhouette, generous margins, no letters, no gradients, no shadows, no radio mockup, no people. Logo-ready SVG.
